    • placeStoredPowder

      public boolean placeStoredPowder(net.minecraft.world.level.Level level, net.minecraft.world.phys.BlockHitResult hit, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack stack, com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.protection.ProtectionContext context, boolean allowFaceOffset)
      On the player-use path NeoForge defers EntityPlaceEvent past useOn return and its held-stack rollback restores from a live component map, so it cannot undo a custom_data debit. This fires the place event itself, observes any cancellation before debiting, and finalizes the captured snapshots. Automation (no armed snapshot capture) places directly and lets place() fire the event.
      Specified by:
      placeStoredPowder in interface com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.platform.BucketOperations
